question: Which of the following novels is the first in the series of the trilogy written by Akshat Gupta?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Hidden Hindu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Akshat Gupta's work **is based on the Hindu notion of the seven immortals, who are believed to stay alive long after the end of the period (yug) in which they were born.
 
• He is one of the most prominent writers.His famous works are-** Arya the Brave Boy and Concealed Existence, etc**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7cfbe53f656c28e83a9740215ac66d97851fa6d6f2fc6333f89c0e3de273bd7.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The story of** King Dashrath of Ayodhya **being defeated in a war by Lankan trader Raavan, and the birth of his son Rami is expressed in the book **Scion of Ikshvavku by Amish Tripathi **an Indian author.
 
• He is known best for his Shiva Trilogy and Ram Chandra Series.
 
• In the **Immortals of Meluha,** comes to the fictitious land of Meluha. Shiva This book is a fictional account of a person named** Shiva based on the epic stories of Lord Shiva.**
 
• **Pattanaik's 7 Secrets **essentially cover seven manifestations of the goddess:** Gaia, Kali, Gauri, Durga, Lakshmi, Saraswati and Vitthai**.
 
• These take us through a generic, universal mother goddess, five of the classical Hindu female deities and one folk goddess from western India.
